title: Filtering by status returns every task except the ones I asked for
body:
### What happens
When I filter the task list by status, I get the opposite of what I asked for.

### Steps to reproduce
1. `POST /tasks` with `{"title": "a", "status": "pending"}`
2. `POST /tasks` with `{"title": "b", "status": "completed"}`
3. `POST /tasks` with `{"title": "c", "status": "in_progress"}`
4. `GET /tasks?status=pending`

### Expected
Only task `a`.

### Actual
Tasks `b` and `c` are returned, and `a` is missing.

### Environment
Latest `main`, SQLite storage.

title: Priority filter is ignored unless a status filter is also given
body:
### What happens
`GET /tasks?priority=high` returns all tasks, including low and medium priority ones.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Create one task with `"priority": "high"` and one with `"priority": "low"`.
2. `GET /tasks?priority=high`

### Expected
Only the high-priority task.

### Actual
Both tasks are returned. Oddly, `GET /tasks?status=pending&priority=high` does filter by priority.

title: PATCH with a single field returns 500 Internal Server Error
body:
### What happens
I can't mark a task as completed without resending every field.

### Steps to reproduce
1. `POST /tasks` with `{"title": "write report"}` -> id 1
2. `PATCH /tasks/1` with `{"status": "completed"}`

### Expected
200 and the task with `status: completed`; the other fields are unchanged.

### Actual
500 Internal Server Error. It works only if I send title, status and priority together.

title: A task title made only of spaces is accepted
body:
### What happens
The API accepts a blank title.

### Steps to reproduce
`POST /tasks` with `{"title": "   "}`

### Expected
422 Unprocessable Entity: a title must not be blank.

### Actual
201 Created, and the task is stored with an empty title `""`.

title: PATCH on a task that does not exist returns 500 instead of 404
body:
### What happens
Updating a missing task crashes the server.

### Steps to reproduce
`PATCH /tasks/9999` with `{"title": "x"}` on an empty database.

### Expected
404 Not Found, the same as `GET /tasks/9999` and `DELETE /tasks/9999`.

### Actual
500 Internal Server Error.
